entities.summary: Yeum Hye-seon is a South Korean volleyball player. She was part of the South Korea women's national volleyball team at the 2016 Summer Olympics and 2020 Summer Olympics. She was selected as the "Best Setter" in the 2020 Olympics. Her team finished in fifth place in the 2016 Olympics and fourth in the 2020 Olympics.
